text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Is today's lunch Western food or
Japanese food?
Let the coin decide!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh no... Where'd my coin go?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch... It was the most balanced one I
had, and it
was so easy to toss too...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I was lying down over there, so maybe
it's under
the bed... Ugh! I guess I'll have
to move it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa tires herself out moving
around
her furniture to find her missing
coin.
